description: Advanced compliance rules with severity levels and evidence tracking

rules.name: Product Name/Description
rules.description: Product name or brief description must be clearly declared on the package

rules.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
rules.description: MRP must be clearly displayed on the principal display panel. Format: ₹ or Rs followed by numeric value
rules.legal_reference: Schedule I, Rule 6, Legal Metrology Rules 2011

rules.name: Net Quantity/Weight
rules.description: Net quantity/weight must be declared in SI units (g, kg, ml, l)
rules.legal_reference: Schedule I, Rule 7, Legal Metrology Rules 2011

rules.name: Manufacturer/Distributor Name and Address
rules.description: Name and address of manufacturer or distributor must be clearly displayed
rules.legal_reference: Schedule I, Rule 8, Legal Metrology Rules 2011

rules.name: Consumer Care Instructions
rules.description: If applicable to product, consumer care and storage instructions must be provided

rules.name: Packer's Name and Address
rules.description: If packer is different from manufacturer, packer's details must be displayed

rules.name: Importer's Name and Address
rules.description: For imported goods, importer's details must be displayed

rules.name: Manufacturing/Packing Date
rules.description: Manufacturing or packing date should be provided where applicable

rules.name: Text Readability and Visibility
rules.description: All declarations must be printed in legible font with adequate contrast

rules.name: Data Consistency Across Images
rules.description: When multiple images provided (front, back, etc.), critical fields should not conflict

mandatory_declaration.description: Fields that must be present on all packaged commodities

conditional_declaration.description: Fields that must be present based on product type or origin

cross_field_validation.description: Validation across multiple fields or images

critical.description: Missing or malformed critical declaration - likely non-compliant

high.description: Important declaration missing or unclear - requires verification

low.description: Minor issue - unlikely to affect compliance

disclaimers: This is an AI-assisted preliminary assessment only.
This system cannot replace human expert verification by legal metrology officers.
All preliminary findings must be verified by authorized enforcement officers.
This assessment is based on OCR text extraction which may have limitations.
Legal compliance determination must be made by qualified personnel with reference to the actual packaged commodity and applicable regulations.
Rules version 2.0 reflects guidelines as of August 2026. Refer to official documents for latest updates.
